stem: In the circle with center \(O\) shown, the measure of central angle \(AOB\) is \(100^{\circ}\). What is the measure, in degrees, of major arc \(AB\)?
solution: The minor arc \(AB\) has the same measure as its central angle, \(100^{\circ}\).
The whole circle measures \(360^{\circ}\), so the major arc measures \(360^{\circ} - 100^{\circ} = 260^{\circ}\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is half of the major arc, the measure of an inscribed angle that intercepts it.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This halves the central angle, as for an inscribed angle; an arc has the same measure as its central angle.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the measure of minor arc \(AB\), not major arc \(AB\).

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'C': 'A', 'D': 'B', 'A': 'C', 'B': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'C', 'B': 'D', 'C': 'A', 'D': 'B'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert abs(ang('A','O','B')-100)<0.1 and abs(d('O','A')-5)<0.01 and abs(d('O','B')-5)<0.01
ans=360-100
assert simplify(value(choices[answer])-ans)==0
assert all(simplify(value(choices[k])-ans)!=0 for k in choices if k!=answer)
